newsitem.title: USA: Cajun Elec. sees 575 MW coal-fired unit back Weds.
newsitem.headline: Cajun Elec. sees 575 MW coal-fired unit back Weds.

text.p: Cajun Electric Power Cooperative's 575 megawatt (MW) coal-fired unit, which is part of the Big Cajun Two power plant, is expected to return to service Wednesday morning, the company said Tuesday.
The Baton Rouge, La., unit was shut early Tuesday morning due to a tube leak, a company spokesman said.
Big Cajun Two's two other coal units, with generating capacities of 540 MW and 575 MW, are operating at full power.
Cajun Electric's two 110 MW natural gas-fired units at the Big Cajun Two power plant are also operating normally.
